puntoEncuentro: Departure from Marunouchi North Exit (Tokyo Station) at 9:00 AM
descripcion:
Escape with us from the noise of the megalopolis and step into the city that was the centre of samurai power for more than a century. This morning tour is designed for those who want the essence of Kamakura — to feel the weight of history and understand why this small coastal corner forever changed the fate of Japan.

Itinerary:
We will depart at 9:00 AM from Tokyo Station. We will begin at Hase-dera, the temple of the goddess Kannon. From there, we will make our way to Kotoku-in to come face to face with the Great Buddha, the Daibutsu. We will close the tour at Tsurugaoka Hachiman-gu, the grand Shinto shrine that for centuries served as the spiritual and political heart of the shogunate. By lunchtime, Komachi-dori Street awaits with its stalls, traditional sweets, and small restaurants — the perfect place to end the tour.

Accessibility and Recommendations:
This tour is accessible to everyone as there are no steep slopes or uneven pavements. We recommend wearing comfortable clothing, bringing water to stay hydrated, sun protection, and a hat.
incluye: Spanish-speaking guide throughout the private tour
Historical explanations of the sites visited
Entrance fees to two temples included

puntoEncuentro: Next to the Asakusa tourist information building at 9:00 AM
descripcion:
Discover with us the city that never stops surprising. This full-day tour is designed for those who want to understand Tokyo — not just see it, but feel it and grasp why millions of people consider it the most fascinating city on the planet.

Itinerary:
We will begin at 9:00 AM in Asakusa, the last neighbourhood that preserves the soul of old Tokyo. We will stroll through the Nakamise shopping street all the way to Senso-ji, the Buddhist temple that has welcomed pilgrims for over a thousand years. From there, we will head to the historic Meiji Shrine. Just a few steps away, we will cross into the other side of the mirror: Harajuku and its famous Takeshita Street. We will take a one-hour lunch break at midday, then head to Shibuya, the most photographed crossing in the world. We will finish in Shinjuku, where Tokyo bids a grand farewell.

Accessibility and Recommendations:
This tour is accessible to everyone as there are no steep slopes or uneven pavements. We recommend wearing comfortable clothing, bringing water to stay hydrated, sun protection, and a hat.
incluye: Spanish-speaking guide throughout the entire private tour
Historical and cultural explanations of the sites visited
noIncluye: Food and beverages (1 hour free time for lunch is included)

puntoEncuentro: Umayamichi Park, East Exit (Yoyogi Station) at 18:00
descripcion:
Venture with us into the rawest and most fascinating side of Tokyo on this night tour inspired by articles and series such as Tokyo Vice. Together we will explore the Shinjuku district and its most enigmatic face: Kabukicho, the neighbourhood that never sleeps.

Itinerary:
We will begin at 18:00 at Umayamichi Park, just a short walk from Yoyogi Station. From here we will embark on a tour that reveals how Tokyo's nightlife truly operates: its unwritten codes, its neon lights, and the social structures that work in the shadows. We will analyse the neighbourhood's post-war historical evolution in Omoide Yokocho, its transformation into the epicentre of adult entertainment along the main avenues of Kabukicho, and the influence of the yakuza, Japan's organised crime syndicate. We will visit iconic landmarks such as the giant cat of Shinjuku, Godzilla himself, and places that only the most local of Tokyoites know how to reach.

Dinner option:
Shinjuku is known as the place where Japanese workers come to unwind after a long day. We will visit a typical izakaya restaurant where you can sample yakitori, chicken skewers, karaage, gyoza, and much more. If you choose the tour with dinner, it will conclude at 21:00.

Important notice:
Due to the subjects covered during this tour and the fact that the red-light district will be visited, this tour is not recommended for anyone under 18 years of age.

Accessibility and Recommendations:
This tour is accessible to everyone as there are no steep slopes or uneven pavements. We recommend wearing comfortable clothing, bringing water to stay hydrated, and sun protection.
incluye: Spanish-speaking guide throughout the entire night tour
Historical and cultural explanations of the sites visited
Dinner at a typical Izakaya restaurant (only when the 80 € option is booked)
noIncluye: Food and beverages during the tour (dinner is served at the end)

descripcion:
Discover the most traditional and picturesque side of Kyoto on a tour through some of its most iconic neighborhoods and temples.

We will begin with a walk along the tranquil Kamogawa River, one of the city's favorite spots for locals to relax and enjoy Kyoto's unique atmosphere. We will then head to Gion Shirakawa, one of the most beautiful and photogenic areas of the ancient capital. Its cobblestone streets, traditional wooden townhouses, and willow-lined canals preserve the charm of old Japan and embody the essence of the historic geisha district.

Next, we will visit the impressive Chionin Temple, the head temple of one of Japan's most important Buddhist schools. Its imposing main gate and expansive grounds offer an experience of great cultural and spiritual value.

We will continue through Maruyama Park, one of Kyoto's most famous green spaces, known for its tranquil atmosphere and beautiful scenery throughout all seasons.

Finally, we will arrive at the majestic Kiyomizudera Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Japan's most iconic monuments. Its famous wooden terrace offers spectacular views of the city and provides the perfect conclusion to an experience filled with history, culture, and tradition.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the classic beauty of Kyoto and immerse themselves in the unique atmosphere of Japan's ancient capital.

We will begin by visiting the stunning Kinkakuji Temple, known as the Golden Pavilion and designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Covered in gold leaf and surrounded by traditional gardens and ponds, it is one of the most recognized symbols of Japan.

We will then continue to the famous Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine, renowned for its thousands of vermilion torii gates that wind their way up the mountain. This sacred place offers one of Japan's most iconic images and a unique experience steeped in history and tradition.

We will conclude our tour at the majestic Kiyomizudera Temple, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its spectacular wooden terrace, built without the use of nails, offers magnificent views of Kyoto and stands as one of the country's most important cultural treasures.

A perfect experience for those visiting Kyoto for the first time who wish to discover some of Japan's most famous, beautiful, and historic places all in one tour.

titulo: Feel the Energy of Osaka (3 Hours)
precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the vibrant energy of Osaka on a tour that combines modernity, tradition, and some of the city's most emblematic places.

We will begin at Shinsaibashi, one of Osaka's most popular shopping areas, where streets filled with stores, cafés, and urban life showcase the city's most dynamic side.

We will then head to America Mura, the heart of Osaka's youth culture. With its murals, alternative shops, and creative atmosphere, this neighborhood reflects the modern and carefree spirit that defines the city.

Next we will make our way to Dotonbori, Osaka's most famous district, known for its spectacular illuminated signs, lively atmosphere, and its role as a symbol of the city's nightlife and gastronomic scene. Here you can enjoy some of Japan's most iconic views.

Just steps away, we will visit the traditional Hozenji Temple, a small oasis of tranquility that preserves the charm of historic Osaka and offers an interesting contrast with the busy streets nearby.

We will conclude our tour at Kuromon Market, known as "Osaka's Kitchen." This historic market houses a wide variety of fresh produce, local specialties, and some of the most representative flavors of Japanese cuisine.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the essence of Osaka through its urban culture, traditions, and renowned gastronomic scene.

titulo: Kobe: A City of Taste and Trade (3 Hours)
precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover the unique charm of Kobe, a city where Japanese tradition and international influence come together in an exceptional way.

We will begin our tour in Sannomiya, the heart of the city and the perfect meeting point to explore some of its most iconic places.

Our first stop will be Ikuta Jinja, one of Japan's oldest shrines, with over 1,800 years of history. Surrounded by nature in the very center of the city, this shrine offers a perfect introduction to Kobe's spiritual traditions.

We will then head to the famous Starbucks Kitano Ijinkan, housed in a historic Western-style residence that reflects Kobe's international past. This building, considered one of the most beautiful Starbucks in Japan, allows visitors to appreciate the architecture that characterizes the Kitano district.

We will continue exploring this elegant area until we reach the iconic Weathercock House (Kazamidori no Yakata), one of Kobe's most recognized symbols. Its distinctive architecture and history offer a fascinating glimpse into the era when foreign merchants and diplomats settled in the city.

During the tour we will also pass by Steakland, one of the most popular restaurants for tasting the world-famous Kobe beef, one of Japan's most prestigious culinary specialties.

A perfect experience for those who wish to discover the history, culture, and cosmopolitan atmosphere that have made Kobe one of the most fascinating cities in the country.

Private walking tour experience

titulo: Nara: The Soul of Japan (3 Hours)
precio: $175 USD (Base 2 pax) + $35 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover Japan's ancient capital on a tour filled with history, culture, and traditions.

We will begin at Kintetsu Nara Station, the ideal starting point for exploring one of the country's most historic cities. We will stroll alongside the tranquil Sarusawa-ike Pond, one of Nara's most representative landscapes, surrounded by history and natural beauty.

We will then head to Kōfuku-ji, one of Japan's most important Buddhist temples, famous for its elegant five-story pagoda, the symbol of the city. We will visit the Nara National Museum to learn more about Japanese art and cultural heritage, before making our way to the spectacular Tōdai-ji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This impressive complex houses the Great Buddha of Nara, one of the largest bronze statues in the world and one of Japan's most important cultural treasures.

Throughout the tour you will also have the opportunity to enjoy the unique atmosphere of Nara Park, home to the famous deer regarded as sacred messengers in local tradition.

An ideal experience for those who wish to discover the rich historical, spiritual, and cultural wealth of one of Japan's most fascinating cities. 🦌⛩️✨
incluye: English, Spanish or Portuguese speaking guide
Private walking tour experience

titulo: Nara & Uji: The Origins of Matcha (8 Hours)
precio: $315 USD (Base 2 pax) + $42 USD per additional person
descripcion:
Discover two of Japan's most fascinating cultural destinations on a tour that combines history, spirituality, and traditional gastronomy.

We will begin in Uji, a city famous for producing some of the finest matcha tea in the country. We will visit the stunning Phoenix Pavilion of Byōdō-in, a UNESCO World Heritage Site considered one of the masterpieces of Japanese architecture. We will then stroll along Uji's charming shopping street, lined with specialty matcha shops, traditional sweets, and local products that reflect the rich tea culture of the region.

We will continue to Nara, Japan's first permanent capital. There we will walk alongside the picturesque Sarusawa-ike pond and visit Kōfuku-ji, an important Buddhist temple and UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its historic five-story pagoda.

We will also enjoy a stroll through the famous Nara Park, home to the iconic deer that roam freely among visitors and form part of the city's identity.

The tour will culminate at the majestic Tōdai-ji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site where the Great Buddha of Nara stands as one of the most impressive and iconic bronze statues in Japan.

A perfect experience for those who wish to discover the cultural essence of Japan through its historic temples, centuries-old traditions, and the authentic flavor of Uji matcha. 🍵🦌⛩️✨
